blocks.text: At NUS Business School, students take a transformative journey, and make an A.G.I.L.E leap forward through the Academically rigorous and flexible curriculum, diversity of Global and experiential opportunities, Industry-relevant infrastructure, varied options for Leadership development and highly Entrepreneurial environment. Through the full BBA experience, they forge ahead with confidence and future-readiness, prepared to make the most of an increasingly dynamic and unpredictable world.
